svg.title: SIM-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)

g.text: SIM-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
Validate UI permission vs API operationId input contract;
choose explicit target userId or actor.id().
unchanged → return status, snapshot and decision; changed → retry all reads.
Use Effective.has for the UI permission.
reason and trace carry USER_DISABLED or SYSTEM_DISABLED.
Available target: reason ALLOW or DENY. RestSupport.ok supplies the HTTP envelope.
